description.value: Lucia Gelato is a Whistler-based artisan maker of dense, milk-based gelato and sorbetto crafted from fresh, natural ingredients using traditional Italian techniques. The business operates as a mobile food truck and rotating seasonal outdoor stands at public locations including Lost Lake Park, Whistler Olympic Plaza, and Blackcomb base, putting it squarely on the route of cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor. Gelato is also stocked in 475 mL retail packs at grocery stores across Whistler, Squamish, and Pemberton.

All contact details were sourced from the website's /contact-us/ page as OSM tags contain no phone or address. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom infrastructure is mentioned anywhere on the site; however, the Our Story page explicitly names cyclists as part of the intended audience ('finishing a bike ride'), confirming the business is cycle-tourism-adjacent.
